MEDIA TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MEDIA TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Pre - Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre - Production.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre - Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre - Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre - Production.

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Pre-Production 1.3 Production 1.4 Post-Production 2.0 Media Components 2.1 Photo.

6. When learning Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Production.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Production.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Production.

7. When learning Audio Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audio Production.

10. When learning Photography 2.2 Digital Video Production 2.3 Audio Production 3.0 Media Entrepre, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool

14. When learning Photography, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
